acceptance: test_message_while_running_queues_and_delivers polls until the second completion event is recorded and the worker record is no longer running, within the same 30-second deadline; it still asserts queued_message is None, state idle, the message and resumed events, and the follow-up prompt file
No product code changes and no assertion is removed or weakened; the root cause (the completion event is written before the record leaves running) is stated in the test's comment
The test passes 20 consecutive runs under pytest -n auto with a parallel CPU load (for example pytest-repeat or a loop), recorded in the sheet
nodes.title: The queued-message worker test waits for the idle state, not just the second completion event

acceptance: specy-road init project (not --dry-run) also writes roadmap.md and roadmap-context.md from the scaffold graph by reusing generated_files.regenerate_generated_files, and lists both in its written paths; --dry-run lists them as would-write and adds no path. tests/test_init_project_reports.py asserts the real run's new files equal the listed names for a flat layout and for project root sr/

The starter roster placeholder (id my-executor, no harness and no channels.cli; id kept in one constant that a test checks against the template) produces no 'matches no model profile' notice; the 'closest profile' hint is shown only when the maximum SequenceMatcher(None, roster_id, name).ratio() over that profile's api_id, file stem and aliases is >= 0.6, otherwise the hint names no profile and keeps 'add one or give the entry profile:'

tests/test_model_profile_aliases.py is table-driven through the public roster_profile_gaps, no private patch: my-executor non-launchable gives no gap; my-executor with a harness or channels.cli gives a gap; another non-launchable unmatched id gives a gap with launchable False (stdout notice); a launchable unmatched id gives launchable True (stderr warning); ratio below 0.6 omits the closest-profile hint; ratio 0.6 or higher includes it

New tests/test_init_project_first_run.py: init project into a tmp git repo, first commit, then validate, validate --strict, export --check and digest --check in-process each exit 0, and combined stdout and stderr contain no notice or warning naming my-executor or vision.md (the zone check is not changed: that notice is untracked-only). docs/install-and-usage.md new-project line says init writes both generated files and the first commit precedes validate; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +25, tests about +80, docs about +5
nodes.title: A freshly initialized project passes its own checks

acceptance: When git remote get-url fails for the resolved remote (--remote, then SPECY_ROAD_REMOTE, then roadmap/git-workflow.yaml, else origin, via resolve_integration_defaults as the fetch uses), doctor skips fetch and the branch, worktree and registry sections, prints one stdout line naming that remote and that those checks were skipped, still runs the install, checkout, stash and orphaned-claim reports, and exits 0 unless checkout is bad or --fix fails on a listed stash; --fix deletes only stashes it listed
A configured remote whose fetch fails still exits 1 with the existing 'git fetch --prune <remote> failed' error; branches prune is unchanged

Table-driven test in tests/test_doctor.py, local git only, no network, no private patch: no remote (exit 0, the skip line, no fetch error); no remote with a toolkit stash (listed and kept without --fix, removed with --fix --yes); no remote with an orphaned claim (printed, not released); no remote with a checkout error (exit 1); configured remote as a local bare repo (exit 0, no skip line); remote pointing at a missing local path (exit 1, existing fetch error)
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +15, tests about +60
nodes.title: doctor works in a repo with no remote

acceptance: specy-road --help points add-node and scaffold-planning at 'specy-road <cmd> -h', never python specy_road/bundled_scripts/... paths; the gui line names 'specy-road init gui --install-gui' with pip install 'specy-road[gui-next]' as the alternative; no command or flag is removed

Subcommand help 'usage:' lines read 'specy-road <cmd>' instead of the module file name (roadmap_crud.py, validate_roadmap.py, ...), set once in cli._run for every bundled entrypoint rather than per script

Help text no longer cites a bare docs/<name>.md that pip installs lack: each is rewritten to the published URL with doc_links.link_toolkit_docs (top-level usage, apply, do-next-available-task --on-complete) or dropped

New tests/test_cli_help_text.py: specy-road --help plus '<cmd> -h' for every name in the public cli.registered_agent_command_names()['specy-road'] except version (orchestration as 'orchestration guard -h'); each row exits 0, its usage line starts with 'usage: specy-road', and it has no 'bundled_scripts/', no usage or 'python ...' line naming a .py file, no bare docs/<name>.md outside doc_links.SHIPPED_DOCS. Top-level help contains 'specy-road init gui --install-gui', "pip install 'specy-road[gui-next]'", 'specy-road add-node -h' and 'specy-road scaffold-planning -h' and not 'specy-road init --install-gui'; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed entry
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +15, tests about +50
nodes.title: Help text names installed commands

acceptance: _second_observation in specy_road/review_record_rules.py refuses a covered joined clause only when at least one joined part names a defect (_named_defect); two or more neutral parts joined by a comma or by and, but, while, whereas, although, though, yet or plus are accepted under one explanation; the docstring, PROBE_RULES_LINES (the reviewer prompt's rule lines) and the matching paragraph of docs/orchestration-review.md state this one rule, and that doc stays within its file limit

A table in the existing test_clause_problem rows of tests/test_review_record_rules.py (the file stays at or under 400 lines) runs public clause_problem over each joiner (comma, and, but, while, whereas, although, though, yet, plus) with neutral/neutral parts (accepted), neutral/defect and defect/neutral parts (refused with the existing message naming the joiner), each line ending in one explanation; it includes 'Changed paths are tests/test_worker_queue_message.py plus sr/work/implementation-summary-M21.8.md' (accepted) and 'The cache is cold plus the lock crashes' (refused, naming plus)

The rows in tests/test_review_friction_m15_17.py that refused only neutral joins are changed to expect acceptance and are listed in this leaf's sheet; clause_problem's other rules are unchanged (an unexplained clause naming a defect is refused; a reason that itself names a defect is refused); CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] Fixed records the change
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +2, tests about +25, docs about 0
nodes.title: A review record is refused for joined observations only when one of them names a defect
